abstract: A standard and a step-by-step procedure for producing every Wugweb piece in two tracks: client work (case studies, portfolio, showcase) and Wugweb's own content (blog posts, service pages, site copy), plus the social, deck, Behance and Dribbble forms of either. Evidence-led and proposal-only: nothing is invented and nothing is written or posted without the owner's approval. Voice, layout, search and planning rules belong to sibling skills; this skill applies them. Independent of CMS, host and agent.
status: Part 1 built from docs/skills/wugweb-work/PLAN.md at commit 3c8ef8c (2026-11-16). Six matters are open with the owner and marked in references/open-items.md. Track 2 body standards are a first draft. Rules owned by sibling skills are held here until those skills are approved. Evals written, not yet run. Part 2 (site code) is out of scope.
